capabilities: Annotate selected text in Reading view
Show notes as gutter cards or hover bubbles
Style text marks, card skins and card widths
List, edit and re-anchor annotations in an overview panel
Export annotations to a Markdown review list
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; the cards are read-time margin notes attached to lines of text.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); mobile is unsupported and untested. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer, and following the app language needs 1.8.7 or newer. No network access or telemetry; uninstalling leaves notes and the annotation JSON file in place.
problem: Annotating text in Obsidian usually means writing into the note itself, which clutters the Markdown and complicates syncing, diffing and version control.
summary: Reading-view annotation tool that places notes in the page gutter beside the annotated line and keeps every annotation in one JSON file, leaving Markdown untouched.
